text:
ryan_sales: Flagging a weird 429 pattern for Prospect Helio — intermittent 429s during a bulk embeddings import. Demo in 12h. Need rapid presales triage. @ishani_se @mike_eng

ishani_se: Can you paste the raw error and describe their import runner (workers, batch_size, retries)?

ryan_sales: Error sample: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 120
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 6
{"error":{"message":"rate limit exceeded"}}
```
They run 80 workers, batch_size=300, with a naive retry (no jitter). Also some chat calls interleaved for metadata enrichment.

mike_eng: Looking at tenant config (HEL-33): per-route cap=120 r/s, token soft cap approx 130k tok/s. But metrics show token/sec spikes to >200k for ~10s bursts causing token-bucket exhaustion. Also seeing burst-window accounting drift when many concurrent connections start simultaneously 12.

zoe_infra: Hosted shared pool; autoscale won't help for trial tenants. Mitigations: (1) apply a 2-hour tenant soft bump to 200 r/s with ttl, (2) enable per-route request queueing (max_inflight=35) to smooth initial ramp, (3) enable short client-side ramp (start 5 workers and scale up).

pat_sre: Also recommend we add server-side jittered accept windows for imports to avoid synchronized starts causing token-bucket underflow. Short term queueing + bump is faster. Ops approval needed for bump.

helpdesk_bot: helpdesk_bot: "ticket created: ops-change-hel-77 for tenant HEL-33 by mike_eng"

mike_eng: Requesting change: soft_quota=200 r/s, route_queueing=true, max_inflight=35, ttl=3h. Will enable enhanced logging of X-RateLimit-* headers and token/sec every 5s.

helpdesk_bot: helpdesk_bot: "deploy: applying config cfg_hel_77"

helpdesk_bot: helpdesk_bot: "deploy: config applied (cfg_hel_77)"

may_support: Sent client patch with jittered exponential backoff and a small import runner tweak to ramp workers over 30s. Snippet: 
```python
for i in range(6):
    resp = call_api(batch)
    if resp.status_code == 429:
        time.sleep((2**i) + random.random())
        continue
    break
```

ryan_sales: Client reran import and reports far fewer 429s. A couple appeared when they restarted all workers simultaneously; backoff caught them. Demo looks good.

ishani_se: Root cause: synchronized high-concurrency start + large batch sizes -> transient token/sec spikes that exhaust per-route bucket. Resolution: TTL bump + queueing + client-side stagger and retry. Action items: 
- ishani_se: add presales preflight that flags imports with workers>40 or batch_size>200
- mike_eng/zoe_infra: leave TTL bump in place til post-demo and monitor token/sec; auto-revert after 3h
- may_support: send final best-practices note to customer

ryan_sales: Thanks all for the quick turnaround.
